#| label: setup
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
from IPython.display import Markdown, display, HTML
import base64, io

BLUE, ORANGE, GREEN, GREY, RED, INK = "#1f4fd8", "#E8833A", "#1a7f37", "#888888", "#b5302a", "#222222"
plt.rcParams.update({"mathtext.fontset": "cm", "font.size": 14,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})


def md(s):
    display(Markdown(s))


def r(x, d=3):
    s = f"{x:.{d}f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return "0" if s in ("-0", "") else s


def table(header, rows):
    s = "| " + " | ".join(header) + " |\n|" + ":---:|" * len(header) + "\n"
    s += "\n".join("| " + " | ".join(str(x) for x in row) + " |" for row in rows)
    md(s)


def show(fig, h=None):
    b = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(b, format="png", dpi=150, facecolor="white", bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    style = f' style="max-height:{h}px !important"' if h else ""
    display(HTML(f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode()}"{style}>'))


def png_uri(fig):
    b = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(b, format="png", dpi=150, facecolor="white")          # fixed size: frames line up exactly
    plt.close(fig)
    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode()


def stack(figs, h=520):
    """Frames on top of each other; each click shows the next one."""
    imgs = [f'<img src="{png_uri(figs[0])}" style="max-height:{h}px !important">']
    imgs += [f'<img class="fragment" data-fragment-index="{i}" src="{png_uri(f)}" style="max-height:{h}px !important">' for i, f in enumerate(figs[1:], 1)]
    display(HTML('<div class="r-stack">' + "".join(imgs) + "</div>"))


def ray(ax, u, xmax, ymax, color=None):
    """Faint dashed line continuing the user's arrow to the edge of the plot: only the direction matters."""
    u = np.asarray(u, float)
    t = min(xmax / u[0] if u[0] > 0 else np.inf, ymax / u[1] if u[1] > 0 else np.inf)
    ax.plot([u[0], t * u[0]], [u[1], t * u[1]], ls=(0, (5, 4)), lw=2, color=color or ORANGE, alpha=0.45, zorder=1)


def boxes(stages, w=3.0, gap=0.8, h=2.2, figsize=(15, 3.2), fs=15, sfs=12.5):
    """A left-to-right chain of rounded boxes: stages = [(title, subtitle, face, edge), ...]."""
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    for k, (t, s_, fc, ec) in enumerate(stages):
        x = k * (w + gap)
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, 0), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.06", fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=2))
        ax.text(x + w / 2, h * 0.72, t, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs, fontweight="bold")
        ax.text(x + w / 2, h * 0.32, s_, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=sfs, color="#444")
        if k < len(stages) - 1:
            ax.annotate("", xy=(x + w + gap - 0.08, h / 2), xytext=(x + w + 0.08, h / 2), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=GREY, lw=2))
    ax.set_xlim(-0.2, len(stages) * (w + gap) - gap + 0.2); ax.set_ylim(-0.2, h + 0.3); ax.axis("off")
    return fig


# ---------------- running example: 8 movies, 2 numbers each (funny, action-packed) ----------------
CAT = {"Elf": (2.0, 0.2), "Paddington": (1.6, 0.4),                 # comedies
       "John Wick": (0.2, 2.0), "Mad Max": (0.4, 1.6),               # action
       "Shrek": (1.6, 1.4), "The Incredibles": (1.4, 1.8),           # both
       "The Notebook": (0.2, 0.2), "Titanic": (0.4, 0.6)}            # neither
KIND = {"Elf": "comedy", "Paddington": "comedy", "John Wick": "action", "Mad Max": "action",
        "Shrek": "both", "The Incredibles": "both", "The Notebook": "neither", "Titanic": "neither"}
KCOL = {"comedy": GREEN, "action": RED, "both": "#7b3fb5", "neither": "#6b6b6b"}
rho = np.corrcoef([v[0] for v in CAT.values()], [v[1] for v in CAT.values()])[0, 1]
HIST = ["Paddington", "Shrek", "Titanic"]                          # what Eve watched recently
eve = np.mean([CAT[m] for m in HIST], axis=0)                     # Eve's embedding = average of her history
score = {m: eve @ np.array(v) for m, v in CAT.items()}
cands = sorted([m for m in CAT if m not in HIST], key=lambda m: -score[m])
K = 3
top = cands[:K]
HELD = {"Elf", "Mad Max"}                                         # what Eve actually watched next week
assert abs(rho) < 0.3 and np.allclose(eve, [1.2, 0.8])
assert len({round(score[m], 6) for m in cands}) == len(cands)
assert top == ["The Incredibles", "Elf", "John Wick"] and cands[K] == "Mad Max"
OFF = {"Elf": (0.08, 0.0, "left"), "Paddington": (-0.08, 0.0, "right"), "John Wick": (0.08, 0.0, "left"), "Mad Max": (0.08, 0.0, "left"),
       "Shrek": (0.08, 0.0, "left"), "The Incredibles": (0.09, 0.07, "left"), "The Notebook": (0.08, 0.0, "left"), "Titanic": (-0.08, 0.0, "right")}
OFF2 = {"Elf": (0.1, 0.06, "left"), "Paddington": (-0.1, 0.0, "right"), "John Wick": (0.12, 0.02, "left"), "Mad Max": (0.12, 0.0, "left"),
        "Shrek": (0.1, 0.0, "left"), "The Incredibles": (0.13, 0.08, "left"), "The Notebook": (0.08, -0.07, "left"), "Titanic": (-0.1, 0.03, "right")}


def mcol(m):
    return KCOL[KIND[m]]

# ---------------- practice data ----------------
def emb(v):
    """An embedding as it appears in every table: one decimal each."""
    return f"({v[0]:.1f}, {v[1]:.1f})"


PODS = {"Podcast A": (0.8, 0.2), "Podcast B": (0.2, 0.9), "Podcast C": (0.6, 0.6), "Podcast D": (0.1, 0.4),
        "Podcast E": (0.9, 0.8), "Podcast F": (0.1, 1.2)}
PHIST = ["Podcast E", "Podcast F"]
puser = np.mean([PODS[m] for m in PHIST], axis=0)
pscore = {m: puser @ np.array(v) for m, v in PODS.items()}
pcands = sorted([m for m in PODS if m not in PHIST], key=lambda m: -pscore[m])
PK = 2
ptop = pcands[:PK]
PHELD = {"Podcast C", "Podcast D"}
phits = [m for m in ptop if m in PHELD]
assert np.allclose(puser, [0.5, 1.0])
assert len({round(pscore[m], 6) for m in pcands}) == len(pcands)

## Practice Problem: Build the User's Vector, Then Retrieve {.practice}

A podcast app gives every podcast a 2-number embedding (number 1: news and business, number 2: comedy and stories). **These podcast embeddings were learned beforehand** by the app's model from all users' listening data, so in this problem they are **known**. Only the user's embedding must be computed.

```{python}
table(["Podcast", "Embedding (news, comedy)"], [[m, emb(v)] for m, v in PODS.items()])
```

Last month **the user** listened to **Podcast E** and **Podcast F**.

a. Compute **the user's embedding** as the **average** of the podcasts they listened to.

b. Score every podcast with the **dot product**. Recommend the top 2 that the user has **not** heard.

::: check
**Method:** average-of-items user profile (Rocchio's method; YouTube's 2016 system started this way) + dot-product retrieval of the top K.
:::

::: warn
**Caveat:** on its own, this is a baseline, not what YouTube runs today. Big systems replace the plain average with a neural network (two-tower or transformer). The retrieval step after it (dot product, top K) is exactly what they still do.
:::


```{python}
# ---------------- two standard calculation tables, used on every solution slide ----------------
OR = "#E8833A"


def num(x):
    """A number as it appears in tables: at most 3 decimals, a real minus sign."""
    return r(x, 3).replace("-", "−")


def avg_table(cat, W, reason, name):
    """Weighted average of the embeddings in W (weights), shown the same way every time."""
    rows = []
    for m, w in W.items():
        v = cat[m]
        rows.append([m, emb(v), f"{num(w)} ({reason[m]})",
                     f"${num(w)} \\times {num(v[0])} = {num(w * v[0])}$", f"${num(w)} \\times {num(v[1])} = {num(w * v[1])}$"])
    tot = sum(W.values())
    sx, sy = sum(w * cat[m][0] for m, w in W.items()), sum(w * cat[m][1] for m, w in W.items())
    rows.append(["**total**", "", f"**{num(tot)}**", f"$\\mathbf{{{num(sx)}}}$", f"$\\mathbf{{{num(sy)}}}$"])
    table(["Podcast", "Embedding (news, comedy)", "Weight", "weight × news", "weight × comedy"], rows)
    u = np.array([sx / tot, sy / tot])
    md(f"$$\\mathbf{{u}}_{{\\text{{{name}}}}} = \\left(\\frac{{\\text{{total weight × news}}}}{{\\text{{total weight}}}},\\ \\frac{{\\text{{total weight × comedy}}}}{{\\text{{total weight}}}}\\right) = \\left(\\frac{{{num(sx)}}}{{{num(tot)}}},\\ \\frac{{{num(sy)}}}{{{num(tot)}}}\\right) = ({num(u[0])},\\ {num(u[1])})$$")
    return u


def score_table(cat, u, items, heard=(), k=2):
    """Dot-product scores of u with each item, sorted high to low, the user's numbers in orange."""
    sc = {m: u @ np.array(cat[m]) for m in items}
    pick = [m for m in sorted(items, key=lambda m: -sc[m]) if m not in heard][:k]
    a, b = num(u[0]), num(u[1])
    md(f"The user's embedding is $\\mathbf{{u}} = (\\textcolor{{{OR}}}{{\\mathbf{{{a}}}}}, \\textcolor{{{OR}}}{{\\mathbf{{{b}}}}})$ (orange). "
       f"Score $= \\mathbf{{u}} \\cdot \\mathbf{{v}} = \\textcolor{{{OR}}}{{\\mathbf{{{a}}}}} \\times \\text{{news}} + \\textcolor{{{OR}}}{{\\mathbf{{{b}}}}} \\times \\text{{comedy}}$, sorted from high to low:")
    rows = []
    for m in sorted(items, key=lambda m: -sc[m]):
        v = cat[m]
        p1, p2 = u[0] * v[0], u[1] * v[1]
        rows.append([m, emb(v),
                     f"$\\textcolor{{{OR}}}{{\\mathbf{{{a}}}}} \\times {num(v[0])} = {num(p1)}$",
                     f"$\\textcolor{{{OR}}}{{\\mathbf{{{b}}}}} \\times {num(v[1])} = {num(p2)}$",
                     f"${num(p1)} + {num(p2)} = \\mathbf{{{num(sc[m])}}}$",
                     "heard" if m in heard else ("**recommend**" if m in pick else "")])
    table(["Podcast", "Embedding (news, comedy)", "news part", "comedy part", "Score", ""], rows)
    return sc, pick
```

```{python}
# Round-2 data, needed by the solution slides (also shown on the Round 2 problem slide)
NEW = {"Podcast G": (1.0, 0.5), "Podcast H": (0.1, 1.0), "Podcast I": (0.7, 0.9)}
ALL2 = {**PODS, **NEW}
W_E = {"Podcast E": 1, "Podcast F": 1, "Podcast C": 2, "Podcast D": 2}
W_F = {"Podcast E": 1, "Podcast F": 1, "Podcast C": -1, "Podcast D": 4}
u_e = np.array([sum(w * ALL2[m][k] for m, w in W_E.items()) / sum(W_E.values()) for k in (0, 1)])
u_f = np.array([sum(w * ALL2[m][k] for m, w in W_F.items()) / sum(W_F.values()) for k in (0, 1)])
cand2 = ["Podcast A", "Podcast B", "Podcast G", "Podcast H", "Podcast I"]
top_e = sorted(cand2, key=lambda m: -(u_e @ np.array(ALL2[m])))[:2]
top_f = sorted(cand2, key=lambda m: -(u_f @ np.array(ALL2[m])))[:2]
assert set(top_e) == {"Podcast I", "Podcast G"} and set(top_f) == {"Podcast I", "Podcast H"}
```

```{python}
# ---------------- practice solutions in the examples' layout ----------------
def _w(w):
    return f"({num(w)})" if w < 0 else num(w)


PSTAGE = {
    "ab": dict(items=PODS, W={"Podcast E": 1, "Podcast F": 1}, why={"Podcast E": "heard", "Podcast F": "heard"},
               u=puser, top=ptop, lab=(0.0, 0.13, "center"), note="(E and F score higher, but the user already heard them.)"),
    "c": dict(items=ALL2, W=W_E, why={"Podcast E": "older", "Podcast F": "older", "Podcast C": "this week", "Podcast D": "this week"},
              u=u_e, top=top_e, lab=(-0.05, 0.08, "right"), note="The user's vector moved toward C and D, their newest plays."),
    "d": dict(items=ALL2, W=W_F, why={"Podcast E": "older", "Podcast F": "older", "Podcast C": "not interested", "Podcast D": "this week, liked"},
              u=u_f, top=top_f, lab=(0.06, 0.1, "left"), note="Feedback swapped G (news) for H (stories): the user rejected C and liked D."),
}
for st in PSTAGE.values():
    st["score"] = {m: st["u"] @ np.array(v) for m, v in st["items"].items()}
    st["rank"] = sorted([m for m in st["items"] if m not in st["W"]], key=lambda m: -st["score"][m])
    assert st["rank"][:2] == st["top"] or set(st["rank"][:2]) == set(st["top"])
    st["top"] = st["rank"][:2]


def ps_data(key):
    st = PSTAGE[key]
    table(["Podcast", "(news, comedy)", "Weight"],
          [[m.split()[-1], emb(v), f"**{_w(st['W'][m])}** ({st['why'][m]})" if m in st["W"] else ("new" if m in NEW else "")]
           for m, v in st["items"].items()])


def ps_avg(key):
    st, W = PSTAGE[key], PSTAGE[key]["W"]
    tot = sum(W.values())
    vs = np.sum([w * np.array(st["items"][m]) for m, w in W.items()], axis=0)
    terms = []
    for k, (m, w) in enumerate(W.items()):
        coef = "" if abs(w) == 1 else num(abs(w))
        sign = ("-" if w < 0 else "") if k == 0 else (" - " if w < 0 else " + ")
        terms.append(f"{sign}{coef}{emb(st['items'][m])}")
    head = ("**The user = average of the 2 they heard:**" if key == "ab" else
            "**The user = weighted average.** Weights: " + ", ".join(f"{m.split()[-1]} ×{_w(w)}" for m, w in W.items()) + f"; total = {num(tot)}.")
    md(head + "\n\n" + f"$$\\begin{{aligned}}\\mathbf{{u}} &= \\dfrac{{{''.join(terms)}}}{{{num(tot)}}} \\\\ &= \\dfrac{{({vs[0]:.1f},\\ {vs[1]:.1f})}}{{{num(tot)}}} = ({num(st['u'][0])},\\ {num(st['u'][1])})\\end{{aligned}}$$")
    assert np.allclose(vs / tot, st["u"])


def ps_scores(key):
    st = PSTAGE[key]
    u, sc = st["u"], st["score"]
    md(f"$\\text{{score}} = {num(u[0])} \\times \\text{{news}} + {num(u[1])} \\times \\text{{comedy}}$")
    rows = []
    for m in sorted(st["items"], key=lambda m: -sc[m]):
        v = st["items"][m]
        if m in st["W"]:
            dec = "heard: skip"
        else:
            i = st["rank"].index(m) + 1
            dec = f"**#{i} ✓**" if i <= 2 else f"#{i}"
        nm = m.split()[-1]
        rows.append([f"**{nm}**" if m in st["top"] else nm, f"{num(u[0])}({num(v[0])}) + {num(u[1])}({num(v[1])})", num(sc[m]), dec])
    table(["Podcast", "Calculation", "Score", "Rank"], rows)
    md(f"**Recommend: {' and '.join(m.split()[-1] for m in st['top'])}.** {st['note']}")


def ps_frame(key, k):
    st = PSTAGE[key]
    u, sc, W = st["u"], st["score"], st["W"]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 6.6))
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.1, right=0.97, bottom=0.1, top=0.9)
    if k == 2:
        cut = sc[st["top"][1]]
        gx, gy = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-0.05, 1.25, 200), np.linspace(-0.05, 1.4, 200))
        ax.contour(gx, gy, u[0] * gx + u[1] * gy, levels=[cut], colors="#bbbbbb", linestyles="dashed", linewidths=1.2)
    for m, v in st["items"].items():
        L = m.split()[-1]
        if k == 0:
            c, mk, lab = (BLUE if m not in NEW else "#7b3fb5"), "o", L + (" (new)" if m in NEW else "")
        elif k == 1:
            if m in W:
                c = RED if W[m] < 0 else GREEN
                mk, lab = "s", f"{L} ×{_w(W[m])}"
            else:
                c, mk, lab = "#aaaaaa", "o", L
        else:
            c = GREY if m in W else (GREEN if m in st["top"] else BLUE)
            mk, lab = ("X" if m in W else "o"), f"{L} ({num(sc[m])})"
            if m in st["top"]:
                ax.scatter(*v, s=650, facecolors="none", edgecolors=GREEN, lw=2.5, zorder=3)
        ax.scatter(*v, s=170, color=c, marker=mk, zorder=4)
        ax.text(v[0] + 0.035, v[1] + 0.03, lab, fontsize=13, color=c, fontweight="bold", zorder=5,
                bbox=dict(fc="white", ec="none", alpha=0.8, pad=0.4))
    if k:
        ax.annotate("", xy=u, xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, color=ORANGE, lw=3.5), zorder=2)
        ray(ax, u, 1.25, 1.4)
        dx, dy, ha = st["lab"]
        ax.text(u[0] + dx, u[1] + dy, f"The user\n({num(u[0])}, {num(u[1])})", fontsize=13, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold", ha=ha,
                va="center", zorder=6, bbox=dict(fc="white", ec="none", alpha=0.85, pad=0.4))
    ax.set_xlim(-0.05, 1.25); ax.set_ylim(-0.05, 1.4); ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.set_xlabel("news and business", fontsize=14); ax.set_ylabel("comedy and stories", fontsize=14)
    ax.set_title(["1. The podcasts as points", "2. The user's vector (squares = plays, × weight)",
                  "3. Scores: circled = top 2, X = heard, dashed = cutoff"][k], fontsize=14)
    return fig
```

## Practice Problem, Round 2: One Week Later {.practice}

```{python}
NEW = {"Podcast G": (1.0, 0.5), "Podcast H": (0.1, 1.0), "Podcast I": (0.7, 0.9)}
ALL2 = {**PODS, **NEW}
W_E = {"Podcast E": 1, "Podcast F": 1, "Podcast C": 2, "Podcast D": 2}        # (c) recency weights
W_F = {"Podcast E": 1, "Podcast F": 1, "Podcast C": -1, "Podcast D": 4}       # (d) recency x feedback
def wavg(W):
    tot = sum(W.values())
    return np.array([sum(w * ALL2[m][k] for m, w in W.items()) / tot for k in (0, 1)]), tot
u_e, tot_e = wavg(W_E)
u_f, tot_f = wavg(W_F)
cand2 = ["Podcast A", "Podcast B", "Podcast G", "Podcast H", "Podcast I"]
s_e = {m: u_e @ np.array(ALL2[m]) for m in cand2}
s_f = {m: u_f @ np.array(ALL2[m]) for m in cand2}
top_e = sorted(cand2, key=lambda m: -s_e[m])[:2]
top_f = sorted(cand2, key=lambda m: -s_f[m])[:2]
assert set(top_e) == {"Podcast I", "Podcast G"} and set(top_f) == {"Podcast I", "Podcast H"}
assert np.allclose(u_e, [0.4, 2 / 3]) and np.allclose(u_f, [0.16, 0.60])
table(["New this week", "Embedding (also learned beforehand)"], [[m, emb(v)] for m, v in NEW.items()])
```

The user played **Podcast C** (one of our picks) and **Podcast D** (which we did not recommend); they skipped Podcast B. Three **new** podcasts (G, H, I) were also released this week.

c. Recompute the user's embedding as a **weighted average** of their 4 plays: older plays (E, F) count **1**, this week's plays (C, D) count **2**. Score the 5 podcasts they have not heard (A, B, G, H, I) and recommend the top 2.

d. The user also gave **feedback**: they **liked** Podcast D and tapped **"not interested"** on Podcast C. The app doubles the weight of a liked play and gives a "not interested" play weight **−1**. Recompute their embedding and their top 2.

## The User's Embedding Over Time (Click to Step Through) {.practice}

```{python}
STAGES = [
    dict(title="Start: the podcast catalog", items=list(PODS), heard={}, u=None, top=[], note=""),
    dict(title="Round 1: the user heard E and F → u = average = (0.5, 1)", items=list(PODS), heard={"Podcast E": "heard", "Podcast F": "heard"},
         u=puser, top=ptop, note="recommend B and C"),
    dict(title="Round 2: they played C and D (weight 2) → u = (0.4, 0.667)", items=list(ALL2),
         heard={"Podcast E": "older", "Podcast F": "older", "Podcast C": "played", "Podcast D": "played"}, u=u_e, top=top_e, note="recommend I and G"),
    dict(title="Round 2 + feedback: liked D, \"not interested\" in C → u = (0.16, 0.6)", items=list(ALL2),
         heard={"Podcast E": "older", "Podcast F": "older", "Podcast C": "not interested", "Podcast D": "liked"}, u=u_f, top=top_f,
         note="recommend I and H"),
]


def frame_fig(k):
    st = STAGES[k]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7.2))
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.98, bottom=0.09, top=0.86)
    for j in range(1, k):                                                   # earlier arrows stay as faded ghosts
        ax.annotate("", xy=STAGES[j]["u"], xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, color="#cccccc", lw=2.5, ls="--"))
        ax.text(STAGES[j]["u"][0] + 0.02, STAGES[j]["u"][1] + 0.03, ["", "round 1", "round 2", ""][j], fontsize=11, color=GREY)
    for m in st["items"]:
        v = ALL2[m]
        tag = st["heard"].get(m)
        if tag == "liked":
            col, mk, sz = GREEN, "*", 420
        elif tag == "not interested":
            col, mk, sz = RED, "X", 230
        elif tag:
            col, mk, sz = GREY, "s", 160
        else:
            col, mk, sz = (GREEN if m in st["top"] else BLUE), "o", 160
        ax.scatter(*v, s=sz, color=col, marker=mk, zorder=4)
        lab = m.split()[-1] + (f" ({tag})" if tag in ("liked", "not interested") else "")
        ax.text(v[0] + 0.035, v[1] + 0.035, lab, fontsize=14, color=col, fontweight="bold")
        if m in st["top"]:
            ax.scatter(*v, s=750, facecolors="none", edgecolors=GREEN, lw=2.5, zorder=3)
    if st["u"] is not None:
        u = st["u"]
        ax.annotate("", xy=u, xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, color=ORANGE, lw=4), zorder=5)
        ray(ax, u, 1.2, 1.3)
        ax.scatter(*u, s=120, color=ORANGE, zorder=6)
        dx, dy, ha = (0.03, 0.12, "left") if k == 2 else (0.04, -0.05, "left")      # round-2 label goes above the tip, away from C
        sep = "\n" if k == 2 else " "                                                 # narrower label where space is tight
        ax.text(u[0] + dx, u[1] + dy, f"The user{sep}({num(u[0])}, {num(u[1])})", fontsize=14, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold", ha=ha, va="center",
                zorder=7, bbox=dict(fc="white", ec=ORANGE, lw=1, pad=2, alpha=0.9))
    if st["note"]:
        ax.text(1.17, 0.05, st["note"], fontsize=15, color=GREEN, fontweight="bold", ha="right")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1.2); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.3); ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.set_xlabel("news and business", fontsize=14); ax.set_ylabel("comedy and stories", fontsize=14)
    fig.suptitle(st["title"], fontsize=15, y=0.97)
    fig.text(0.5, 0.905, "■ heard / played     ● not heard     ◯ recommended     → the user's embedding (faded: earlier)", fontsize=12, color=GREY, ha="center")
    return fig


stack([frame_fig(k) for k in range(len(STAGES))])
```
